name: Cá kho phớt
summary: Cá kho phớt is fish braised lightly, one of the daily plates. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study lists it beside the salty braise and says the cooking stays simple, with little spice. No pot time and no stall price were printed.
origin: Cham Islands. The daily catch on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: With rice, at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.
The study does not name a fish or a seasoning. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Cá kho phớt — fish braised lightly, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Fish braised lightly for the daily rice on Tân Hiệp. The 16 September 2025 study prints no recipe. A stall price is Check on arrival.
